main.summary: Generates per-tool manifest companions and assembly bootstrap helpers from analyzed KusDepot tool types.

method.name: Initialize
method.summary: Initializes the incremental pipeline that discovers attributed tool types and schedules manifest source emission.
method.param: The generator initialization context.

method.name: Execute
method.summary: Analyzes the discovered tool types, reports shared diagnostics, and emits source for the valid manifest models.
method.param: The current compilation.
The candidate tool types discovered by the syntax pipeline.
The source production context used to report diagnostics and add generated source.

method.name: ValidateCompanionIdentities
method.summary: Validates generated companion and bootstrap type identities, reports collisions, removes invalid tool models, and indicates whether the bootstrap can be emitted.
method.param: The current compilation, used to detect compatible handwritten partial types and incompatible declarations.
The resolved assembly-level companion settings.
The generated tool models; conflicting models are removed in place.
The generator context used to report collision diagnostics.
method.returns: when the assembly bootstrap can be emitted; otherwise, .

method.name: ResolveNestedCompanionNameCollisions
method.summary: Rewrites colliding nested default companion names to readable containing-type names with stable hash suffixes, while leaving explicit and top-level names unchanged.
method.param: The generated tool models whose nested default-name collisions may be resolved in place.

method.name: ReplaceToolModel
method.summary: Replaces a tool model in the working list with a copy using a resolved companion type name and qualified identity.
method.param: The mutable model list containing the model to replace.
The existing model whose companion identity should be updated.
The resolved companion type name.
The resolved fully qualified companion type name.

method.name: ComputeStableNameHash
method.summary: Computes the first eight uppercase hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of a UTF-8 identity string.
method.param: The stable identity string to hash.
method.returns: An eight-character uppercase hexadecimal hash prefix.

method.name: HasCompatiblePartialType
method.summary: Determines whether an existing source type can be safely extended by the generated internal static partial declaration without duplicating generated members.
method.param: The current compilation containing candidate source declarations.
The namespace of the generated type.
The generated simple type name.
The member names that generated output will declare.
method.returns: when no source type exists or one compatible partial type can be extended; otherwise, .

method.name: GetGeneratedTypeIdentity
method.summary: Formats a namespace and type name as a global-qualified type identity, omitting the namespace qualifier for the global namespace.
method.param: The namespace containing the generated type, or an empty string for the global namespace.
The generated simple type name.
method.returns: The fully qualified generated type identity.

method.name: ReportCompanionTypeCollision
method.summary: Reports the companion type collision diagnostic at the source location of the affected tool.
method.param: The generator context receiving the diagnostic.
The tool model whose generated companion conflicts.
The fully qualified generated companion identity.
The other tool or generated type that conflicts with this companion.

method.name: GenerateAssemblySource
method.summary: Builds the generated assembly bootstrap source that can register and bind every discovered tool manifest companion.
method.param: The current compilation.
The generated tool models to include in the assembly bootstrap.
The resolved assembly-level generation metadata controlling namespace, type-name, and module-initializer behavior.
method.returns: The generated assembly bootstrap source text.

method.name: GenerateToolSource
method.summary: Builds the generated manifest companion source for a single analyzed tool model.
method.param: The tool model to render.

method.name: EscapeStringLiteral
method.summary: Formats a managed string value as a complete C# string literal for generated source emission.
method.param: The string literal value to escape.
method.returns: A complete C# string literal, including delimiters and required escapes.

method.name: SanitizeIdentifier
method.summary: Normalizes arbitrary text into a safe, non-keyword C# identifier for generated type names.
method.param: The source text to sanitize.
